hooks.command: export NO_COLOR=1; deno task --quiet margonem:readings status 2>&1; deno task --quiet margonem:client status 2>&1; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case " $c " in *' add -A '*|*' add --all '*|*' add . '*) echo 'W2: stage by path. A whole-tree add picks up TODO.md (G4).' >&2; exit 2;; *' --no-verify'*|*' commit -n '*) echo 'G8: a hook is never bypassed.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in ''|*/TODO.md) exit 0;; *.md|*.ts|*.json|*.jsonc) out=$(deno fmt --quiet "$f" 2>&1) || case "$out" in *'No target files'*) exit 0;; *) printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2;; esac;; esac; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case " $c " in *' deno add '*|*' deno remove '*|*' deno install '*) exit 0;; esac; git diff --quiet -- deno.lock && exit 0; echo 'deno.lock moved and no dependency was added: a probe wrote to the lock. Restore it from a copy (Ask first: a dependency).' >&2; exit 2
